LESSON: LINES

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: Lines

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Lines. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-068.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 68]]

From your pupil's book (page 68)

GEOMETRY LINES Week 11 Lesson 2 Straight lines Activity Look at the cars

Work to do Show straight lines in class and in school.

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-069.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 69]]

From your pupil's book (page 69)

The children are standing in a curved line

Work to do Show curved lines in class and in school.

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-130.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 130]]

From your pupil's book (page 130)

GEOMETRY Week 10 Lesson 5 LINES Straight lines Activity Make a straight line

Work to do Use plasticine or clay to make straight lines.

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Lines means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Lines.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Lines
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
